Find the ratio of shortest wavelength of Lyman to Balmer series?
questions.solution:
$\frac{1}{\lambda} = RZ^{2}\left(\frac{1}{n_1^{2}} - \frac{1}{n_2^{2}}\right)$
$\frac{1}{\lambda_L} = RZ^{2}\left(\frac{1}{1^{2}} - \frac{1}{\infty}\right)$ .....(i)
And
$\frac{1}{\lambda_B} = RZ^{2}\left(\frac{1}{2^{2}} - \frac{1}{\infty}\right)$ .....(ii)
From (i) and (ii)
$\frac{\lambda_L}{\lambda_B} = \frac{\frac{1}{4}}{1} = \frac{1}{4}$

questions.stem: In the circuit below potential at B and potential at D are same, then find the value of resistance x.
questions.solution:
If $V_B = V_D$
$R_{AB} \times R_{CD} = R_{BC} \times R_{AD}$ (wheatstone bridge type)
As shown in circuit
$R_{AB} = 6\Omega$
$R_{BC} = \frac{1}{2}\Omega$
$R_{CD} = 0.5\Omega$
$R_{AB} = x + 3\Omega$
Using formula
$6(0.5) = (0.5)(x + 3)$
$\Rightarrow x + 3 = 6$
$x = 3\Omega$

While measuring diameter of a wire using a screw gauge the following readings were noted as main scale reading is 1 mm and circular scale reading is equal to 42 division. Pitch of screw gauge is 1mm and it has 100 divisions on circular scale. The diameter of wire is $\frac{x}{50}$ mm. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
Least count $= \frac{\text{Pitch}}{\text{No of division on circular scale}}$
$= \frac{1\ \mathrm{mm}}{100}$
= 0.01 mm
Diameter of wire = 1 mm + $42 \times 0.01$ mm
= 1.42 mm

questions.stem: A hydrogen atom having E energy in ground state, when it is revolving in radius of orbit $r = 8.48$ Å. Its energy become $\frac{E}{x}$. Find the value of x.
questions.solution:
$r = 0.529\frac{n^{2}}{z^{2}}$ Å (for hydrogen z = 1)
$r = 0.529n^{2}$
$\Rightarrow 8.48$ Å $= 0.529n^{2}$
$n^{2} = 16$
$n = 4$
and we know that,
T.E. $= -13.6\frac{z^{2}}{n^{2}}$ eV
At $n = 1 \Rightarrow$ T.E. $= -13.6 = E$
At $n = 4 \Rightarrow$ T.E. $= -\frac{13.6}{4^{2}} = \frac{E}{x}$
$= \frac{E}{x} = \frac{E}{16}$
$x = 16$
